description: Default Renovate preset for dixneuf19 repos

packageRules.description: Python minor/major base image bumps need manual review

The docker datasource only reports a release timestamp for Docker Hub, so on every other registry the timestamp-required default leaves updates pending forever (renovate#37196, renovate#38656, renovate#39064). This also covers oci:// Helm charts, which resolve through the docker datasource
A digest is not a release and carries no timestamp of its own

logLevelRemap.matchMessage: /did not have a releaseTimestamp, but as we're running with minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-optional, proceeding/
